agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Turn 36 ended in a verified whiteout against Sunflora after all viable answers had been spent earlier.

resolution.observed: The corrected turn-6 branch removed Ponyta and Dustox while preserving full-health Bushtank, Croakatoa, and Coppertop for Eelektrik and Sunflora; the causal terminal condition is absent.

findings.observed_fact: Lildozer was the only survivor at 12 HP; Ice Shard damaged Sunflora but Sludge Bomb KO'd it.
findings.next_test: Repair the turn-6 Ponyta threshold and verify the corrected prefix preserves the Sunflora answers before another full clone.

findings.summary: Turn 6 missed the priority-sacrifice rule because Ponyta had 11 HP while the predicate required 10 or less.

resolution.observed: Reloaded turn 6 selected and executed Ice Shard at Lildozer 12 HP versus Ponyta 11 HP, then observed Lildozer's faint and the forced replacement boundary.

findings.observed_fact: Lildozer had 12 HP, Ponyta had 11 HP, and the policy switched to Birdlaw instead of using priority Ice Shard.
findings.why_bad: This one-point threshold miss is the earliest causal divergence and changed every later send-out and reserve state.
findings.improvement: Expand the verified depleted-Lildozer predicate to cover player HP through 15 and Ponyta HP through 12.
findings.next_test: Replay turn 6 and require Ice Shard, Lildozer's expected faint, and a forced full-health Croakatoa replacement.

findings.summary: Turns 6-7 switched Lildozer to Birdlaw to Croakatoa without dealing damage.

resolution.observed: The corrected branch used no voluntary switch: Ice Shard produced a forced replacement and full-health Croakatoa entered directly.

findings.observed_fact: Birdlaw took Flame Wheel from 46 to 28, then Croakatoa took Play Rough from 44 to 29 before Mud Shot finally acted.
findings.why_bad: Two future answers paid entry damage solely because the sacrifice predicate missed.
findings.next_test: The corrected turn-6 line must contain no voluntary switch and must reach the forced replacement menu.

findings.summary: Turn 9 sent Bushtank into Dustox's super-effective Venoshock, reducing it from 57 to 31 before any attack.

resolution.observed: After Croakatoa removed Ponyta, the selector sent full-health Birdlaw directly into Dustox; Bushtank remained at 57 HP.

findings.observed_fact: The scorer selected Bushtank from Croakatoa even though full-health Birdlaw was the designated Dustox attacker.
findings.why_bad: Bushtank's Eelektrik HP reserve was halved and the Dustox role remained unused.
findings.next_test: After the corrected Ponyta prefix, verify Croakatoa hands Dustox directly to full-health Birdlaw.

findings.summary: Turns 11-18 used eight Coppertop Bulldozes into Dustox while recovery and trapping consumed Coppertop from 56 to 8 HP.

resolution.observed: Birdlaw used the committed Aerial Ace line twice and removed Dustox; Coppertop remained untouched at 56 HP and used no Bulldoze PP.

findings.observed_fact: Dustox was still at 44 HP after the eighth Bulldoze; Coppertop then entered Eelektrik at 8 HP and fainted before Tackle.
findings.why_bad: The policy repeated a verified non-progress move and destroyed the reserved Steel converter.
findings.next_test: Verify the corrected prefix activates Birdlaw's committed Aerial Ace rule and never places Coppertop against Dustox.

findings.summary: Turns 25-28 switched Croakatoa to Birdlaw to Bushtank back to Croakatoa and back to Bushtank; Birdlaw and Croakatoa fainted without attacking.

resolution.observed: Reloaded turn 25 with the corrected behavior hash: every unsafe voluntary switch was vetoed and Croakatoa selected Vacuum Wave. Reloaded turn 27 selected Razor Leaf while every second unplanned switch was vetoed.

findings.observed_fact: Birdlaw entered Eelektrik at 28 HP and died to Shock Wave; Croakatoa later re-entered at 10 HP and died to the same move.
findings.why_bad: The policy treated depleted pivots as available roles instead of committing damage or preserving them.
findings.next_test: The corrected prefix must reach Eelektrik with full Bushtank, Croakatoa, and Coppertop; inspect any voluntary switch after Fake Out.

findings.summary: Turns 34-36 reached Sunflora only with 7-HP Ohmnomnom and 12-HP Lildozer, causing two immediate faints.

resolution.observed: At the corrected Eelektrik handoff, Croakatoa and Coppertop were still full health and Bushtank was 57 HP; the selector chose the safe Bushtank pivot instead of spending the Sunflora answers.

findings.observed_fact: Sunflora remained at 38 HP after Ohmnomnom's attack; every healthier matchup answer had already fainted.
findings.why_bad: This was the terminal consequence of the Ponyta, Dustox, and Eelektrik reserve failures.
findings.next_test: A new full clone must enter Sunflora with Croakatoa or Coppertop healthy enough to execute damage and preserve a finisher.

findings.summary: The loss used 13 switches and 36 actions, including two separate no-progress switch chains.
findings.observed_fact: The historical clean win used 22 actions; this line spent 14 more and lost.
findings.next_test: Count switches in the next clone and inspect every voluntary reversal.

findings.summary: Eight Bulldoze PP and multiple full-health reserves were spent without removing Dustox or Eelektrik efficiently.
findings.observed_fact: Coppertop used eight of twenty Bulldoze PP on Dustox and contributed no Eelektrik damage.
findings.next_test: Re-measure PP after Dustox is routed to Birdlaw.

correct_choices: Turns 1-2 correctly removed Bibarel with two Sparks.
Turns 3-5 correctly used Lildozer and two consecutive Bulldozes against Ponyta.
Turn 24 correctly used fresh-entry Fake Out against Eelektrik and took no reply.
Turns 32-33 correctly committed Spark to finish Eelektrik once switching resources were exhausted.
All 36 actions were acknowledged and verified; no tooling discrepancy or hidden extra input caused this loss.
agent_review.next_test: Broaden only the verified turn-6 sacrifice threshold, replay that attached state, then replay the resulting Croakatoa-to-Birdlaw Dustox prefix before another full clone.
